title: Business accounts
description: Companies that book on account, with their discount and billing details

help.title: About business accounts
help.overview: A business account is billed instead of the driver. Its discount is a line on the booking, and invoices use its name, VAT number and address.

sections.title: On this page
items: Put the account on a staff booking and choose On account.
Open an account and choose Monthly statement.
